camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateHostAccount --region cn-hangzhou --ProtocolName SSH --HostAccountName accountname --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostId 1
description_en: After you create a host in Bastionhost, you can create a host account for the host to manage the existing account of the host in Bastionhost. After you create a host account, O&M engineers can use the account to log on to the host through Bastionhost for O&M operations
description_zh: 在堡垒机中新建主机后，您可以为其创建相应的主机账户，即将您主机已有的账户托管至堡垒机。创建主机账户后，运维人员即可使用该账户通过堡垒机登录主机进行运维
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-host-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --protocol-name SSH --host-account-name accountname --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateHostAccount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance where the host for which you want to create a host account resides.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the Bastionhost instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建主机账户的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where the host for which you want to create a host account resides.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建主机账户的主机所在堡垒机的地域ID。

地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the host for which you want to create a host account.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建主机账户的主机ID。

可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: host_id

parameters.help_en:
The protocol name of the host account to create.
Valid values: SSH RDP
parameters.help_zh:
指定新建主机账户的协议名称。
取值： SSH RDP
parameters.name: protocol_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the host account to create. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定新建主机账户的名称，最长支持128字符
parameters.name: host_account_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the host account to create
parameters.help_zh: 指定新建主机账户的密码
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
The private key of the host account to create. The value is a Base64-encoded string.

This parameter takes effect only when ProtocolName is set to SSH. You do not need to configure this parameter when ProtocolName is set to RDP. You can configure both a password and a private key for the host account. When connecting to an asset, Bastionhost preferentially uses the private key
parameters.help_zh:
指定新建主机账户的私钥，即使用Base64编码后的字符串。

主机账户协议ProtocolName为SSH时，该参数生效。ProtocolName为RDP时，无需配置该参数。支持同时为主机账户配置密码和私钥。在连接资产时，堡垒机会优先使用私钥进行连接
parameters.name: private_key

parameters.help_en:
The passphrase of the private key for the host account to create.

You can configure this parameter when ProtocolName is set to SSH. You do not need to configure this parameter when ProtocolName is set to RDP
parameters.help_zh:
定新建主机账户的私钥口令。

主机账户协议ProtocolName为SSH时，您可以配置该参数。ProtocolName为RDP时，无需配置该参数
parameters.name: pass_phrase

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared key for the host
parameters.name: host_share_key_id

parameters.help_en:
The privilege type of the account. Default value: Normal.
Privileged: privileged account.
Normal: standard account.
Only supported in V3.2.47 and later
parameters.help_zh:
账户权限类型，不填时默认为Normal
Privileged：特权账户
Normal：普通账户
仅支持V3.2.47及以上的版本使用
parameters.name: privilege_type

parameters.help_en:
The password rotation mode of the account. Default value: Self.
Privileged: uses a privileged account to rotate the password.
Self: does not use a privileged account to rotate the password.
Only supported in V3.2.47 and later
parameters.help_zh:
账户改密模式，不填时默认为Self
Privileged：使用特权账户改密
Self：不使用特权账户改密
仅支持V3.2.47及以上的版本使用
parameters.name: rotation_mode

HostAccountId.description_en: The ID of the host account

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
